title: Cross-Plane V8
blurb: A running cutaway Chevrolet small-block 350: pistons on true slider-crank geometry, a cam ground to GM’s published specs, and exhaust synthesised from each bank’s pulse timing. Crankpins at 0-90-270-180 give each pipe pulses 270°, 180°, 90° and 180° apart: the burble. Swap in a flat-plane crank and it shrieks and shakes.
